power_up_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

power_down_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

explosive_kg.note: no source gives its charge: 37 % of its warhead, the median share of the game reference's charges (War Thunder's) - an estimate

gurney_kms.note: no source names its explosive: as PBXN-110, a modern HMX-based fill - an estimate

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.00226, its base 0.00056, its fins' friction 0.00194 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 0.0360 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.989 for its fineness 23.1 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)
